No collision, nobody hurt; driver has switched off the engine.

sentences: 7.5-tonne box van reg NV70 CDX on a Halcyon Medical run.
Rear tyre puncture; driver pulled into a lay-by on the A30 near Bodmin; spare wheel missing from the cradle.
Load: dialysis fluids and consumables for a county hospital renal unit, booked slot 11:00.
Now 10:05; tyre service ETA 90 minutes, so the 11:00 slot will be missed.
Driver safe in the lay-by.
